notes.title: Axiom Verge 2 lands on Steam with Linux support and Steam Deck Verified
notes.notes:
Axiom Verge 2 from Thomas Happ Games has jumped over from the Epic Store to Steam and it comes with Native Linux support and it is also Steam Deck Verified!

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/08/axiom-verge-2-lands-on-steam-with-linux-support-and-steam-deck-verified
